overview: Resource Allocation = Deadlock. 4 skills: minimum resources jisse deadlock kabhi na ho (formula), Banker's algorithm se safe state check, allocation graph/scenario me deadlock detect karna, aur prevention/avoidance theory.
whyItMatters: 27 PYQs; min-resources formula aur Banker's safe-sequence dono fully mechanical hain.
coreConcept: Deadlock = processes ka ek group jahan har process us resource ka wait kar raha hai jo doosre ke paas hai. Chaar Coffman conditions ek saath hone chahiye: Mutual Exclusion, Hold and Wait, No Preemption, Circular Wait. Koi ek tod do to deadlock nahi (prevention).
hinglishExplanation: Do log darwaze pe: A ne left key li hai, B ne right key, dono ko doosri key chahiye. Koi peeche nahi hat sakta, koi aage nahi badh sakta — yehi deadlock. Banker's algorithm bank manager jaisa hai: loan tabhi deta hai jab guarantee ho ki sab clients ka kaam kabhi na kabhi poora ho sakta hai (safe state).
formalDefinition: Safe state: ek sequence exists jisme har process apni max need poori karke finish ho sake. Unsafe state deadlock ki guarantee nahi, sirf possibility hai.
importantProperties: Deadlock-free guarantee: n processes, har ek ko max k units chahiye, total R units: R >= n(k-1)+1 hone par deadlock kabhi nahi hoga.
Isliye maximum n for deadlock-free = floor((R-1)/(k-1)).
Different max demands (k1..kn): deadlock-free ke liye R >= sum(ki-1)+1.
Banker's algorithm: Need = Max - Allocation; Work = Available; koi bhi process jiska Need <= Work ho, use finish karo aur Work += Allocation; sab finish ho gaye to safe.
Resource allocation graph me har resource ka single instance ho to cycle = deadlock; multiple instances me cycle sirf necessary hai, sufficient nahi.
Circular wait deadlock ke liye necessary hai. Resource ordering (numbered resources, sirf badhte order me request) circular wait tod deta hai — valid prevention.
Deadlock prevention requests ko rok kar conditions todta hai; avoidance (Banker's) safe state ke basis par grant karta hai — safe state ki jaanch avoidance ka kaam hai, prevention ka nahi.
Sab resources release karke hi nayi request karne wali policy me deadlock nahi hoga, par starvation ho sakta hai.

formulas.deadlockFreeMinR: R >= n*(k-1) + 1 (each process max k units)
formulas.safeSequenceRule: Pick process with Need <= Work; Work = Work + Allocation; repeat until all finish
formulas.coffman: Mutual exclusion + Hold and wait + No preemption + Circular wait

keyPropertiesAndIdentities: Worst case sochne ka tareeka: har process ko (k-1) units de do; ab ek aur unit bache to koi ek process finish ho jaayega.
Multi-instance RAG me cycle hone par bhi deadlock na ho sakta hai.
commonPitfalls: Formula me k ki jagah k-1 use karna bhool jaana (R >= n(k-1)+1).
Banker's me Need ki jagah Max compare kar dena.
'Deadlock hai' aur 'deadlock ho sakta hai' me farak na karna.
standardTechniques: Min-resources: worst-case allocation (k-1 each) socho aur +1 karo.
Banker's: Need matrix banao, Work vector maintain karo, step-by-step processes finish karo.
Graph/scenario: pehle single-instance ya multi-instance dekho, phir wait-for cycle dhundo.
